description: Exact package IDs and versions the scaffold script may put into a generated test project. Package names are never chosen by a language model. Change this file deliberately: re-check versions on nuget.org and check that a test project of every profile still restores, builds and runs.

vstest-xunitv3.note: xunit.v3.mtp-off is xunit.v3 without Microsoft.Testing.Platform, so classic 'dotnet test' (VSTest) keeps working on the .NET 9 and 10 SDKs. The plain 'xunit.v3' package fails with 'Testing with VSTest target is no longer supported' on the .NET 10 SDK (verified 2026-10-18).

mtp-xunitv3.note: Only for repositories whose global.json selects the Microsoft.Testing.Platform runner (SDK 10+). Scaffolded, built and run with dtt run on SDK 10.0.402 (2026-10-27); on SDK 9 these MTP v2 packages are not supported by dtt run.

efCoreTestDatabase.versionFrom: the target project's own Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore version (exact match, never a version chosen here)

notes: Moq 4.20.0 and 4.20.1 shipped SponsorLink (read local git data at build time); this plugin never adds Moq.
An existing test project's own packages always win; this file is only used when a new test project has to be created.
